how: Members ask others to keep the standing sprite and later request defense against attackers.
Official titles endorse the campaign, while a separate instruction asks members to add the design.
A member answers the opening call by committing all their dots to the sprite.
Members explicitly compare their manpower with the taskbar's power and conclude they cannot hold the original spot by fighting.
A question about another Vocaloid receives a clarification that the work is lettering rather than another character.
Relief after the common ending does not establish an individual quitting under strain or a repaired interpersonal quarrel.
Members propose boxing in the sprite, adding another character, and later shrinking the design.
Members report boxing completed, announce the sprite complete, and later report missing or bulldozed parts.
The first visible call describes an existing sprite, leaving its original proposer, mapper, or first placer unidentified.
Members circulate relocation templates and direct builders to the newest version.
Members route building discussion to chat while templates and new plans remain available in the thread.
Invitations and returning plans establish coordination across venues without exposing how the chat decided or ratified those plans.
Sending helpers to a chat does not establish secrecy, coded strategy, or infiltration of a rival venue.
Declared offices make this a local minority case, while conditional self-appointment does not establish collectively accepted command or contradict the population claim.
A participant fits attempted help around homework at five in the morning, and another later welcomes freedom from five-minute placing intervals.
Time burdens and chat routing provide no evidence deciding whether placement scripts or spare accounts were used.
The fixed ending is stated, but site faults, client glitches, and technical fixes remain unobserved.
Members protect an existing sprite, add its border, call for defense, and promise continued protection.
Informed participants may authorise temporary holding, so continued defense does not establish that keepers repaired agreed changes away through ignorance.
Damage reports do not trace particular placers or establish friendly fire, mistakes, or blame directed at officers.
A participant names the taskbar threat and proposes a treaty to avoid destruction, followed by reports of a protection agreement.
Members carry proposals outward, arrange a representative's handoff, and volunteer as the room's liaison.
The room credits a kindred subreddit with negotiating a shared protection and relocation arrangement.
The reported bargain exchanges space for promised protection, while helping the neighbour is offered as an optional task.
Reported terms and optional assistance establish a bargain without verifying delivered protection or actual cross-room pixel labour.
Builders are instructed to maintain the old picture without interfering with the neighbour's work.
The negotiated destination places a smaller sprite within the stronger neighbour's taskbar in exchange for protection.
Negotiated hosting and build instructions do not verify completed occupation or enforcement of the host's rules.
Members plan taskbar incorporation and a smaller design while maintaining the original picture remains an authorised option.
A participant makes moving conditional on a ready building spot, and the liaison answers by temporarily holding the picture.
The participant explicitly explains pre-loss relocation planning through inability to fight the stronger neighbour, rather than through an already completed erasure.
A report that the picture is being bulldozed receives an explicit answer that it must be rebuilt at another location.
Loss followed by a rebuilding instruction establishes intended relocation, while earlier planning and a later cutoff correction prevent inferring a completed replacement.
A visitor naming another home community and a conditional border petition do not establish dual belonging or divided loyalty.
Fear of being overrun does not establish an argument about whether covering others' work is fair.
Conditional self-appointment, deal-finding questions, and timing disagreement do not explicitly deny authority or state a limit on binding placers.
Members appreciate the sprite, celebrate representation, and thank helpers, later valuing their surviving small mark.
Members make a situational image joke about a neighbouring logo and available resolution, joined by agreement, an intention clarification, and laughter.
Representation and shared laughter do not establish that this particular joke, lore, or ideology was carried in from the room's prior life.
The stated threat concerns canvas expansion, leaving any pre-canvas quarrel unidentified.
No cited offensive attack is linked to an inherited rivalry, so the local record cannot test that attack mechanism.
Official campaign and liaison references address an existing subreddit without documenting a new room forming around the canvas mark.
The image joke and intention clarification do not establish objections to offensive words, slurs, or hate symbols.
The megathread gathers completion, diplomacy, current templates, and work instructions into one opening.
Post-event image joking does not establish an April Fools takeover or deceptive framing of the earlier campaign.
A defense call does not document opposition to canvas posts turning into an attack on the room's own mark.
Members mark the ending, mourn damage, correct a rebuilding promise, and reflect on release from constant placing.
Members correct a stale rebuilding promise before its proposer acknowledges that the event has ended.
Closure includes relief from five-minute upkeep as well as mourning and pride in the surviving mark.
Ideal-place posts and comments retrospectively interpret a pictured sprite, neighbouring logo, and possible resolution.
Surviving titles and comments support retrospective joking but cannot determine whether unseen images are final screenshots, cleanups, or counterfactual compositions.
An intention clarification about a picture does not establish competing preserved versions or a correction of an event history.
The rebuilding promise names no successor canvas or durable reuse and is answered by the fact that placement has ended.
A visitor identifies another home community and opens discussion of a related canvas relocation problem.
Arrival through canvas coordination does not establish subscribing, onboarding, or sustained membership after the event.
Hoping for greater canvas visibility does not establish addressing creators, a company, a team, or the press.
The visible call requests defense, while the neighbouring-logo joke supplies no evidence of an intentional local offensive campaign.
Reports of expansion pressure and retrospective joking do not establish taunts, victory claims, or a sustained contest in talk.
The call precedes further building reports but already describes a standing mark, so it cannot explain the mark's original creation.
Because the first visible call names an existing sprite, the record cannot establish an original starter preceding that call.
Keeping is present in the first call and overlaps construction, rather than beginning only after the recorded completion announcement.
The speaker explicitly explains proposing a treaty as a response to the taskbar threatening the sprite.
The announced deal accompanies a public instruction not to interfere with the neighbour, without proving every placer's compliance.
Defense is visible but no cited passage links its demands to placement automation or spare accounts.
Completion reports precede appreciation in the thread, but the short comments do not establish a specific completion report as their cause.
Early appreciation precedes retrospective posts, but no cited passage makes appreciation the cause of preserving or modifying a record.
Retrospective material is visible without a cited decision to carry the effort into another canvas or durable reuse.
Power disadvantage explicitly motivates pre-loss planning, but defense continues after the move announcement and completed relocation remains unresolved.
A smaller-design request receives a work commitment before a template appears, yet a later participant still contests moving before a spot is ready.
The opening call receives a bare commitment of all the member's dots, showing acceptance without demonstrating obligations for every reader.
The reported protection bargain does not verify external helpers arriving or show that a shortage of hands caused their arrival.
Negotiation yields reported space-for-protection terms, while delivered help and actual reciprocal placing remain unresolved.
The cited calls recruit protection rather than an offensive attack, leaving any call-to-attack sequence unobserved.
The restraint instruction has no cited preceding local attack call, preventing a test of attack causing refusal or restraint.
The treaty is explained through an external threat rather than a cited local attack call, leaving the attack-to-negotiation mechanism untestable.
No cited local attack call anchors a later campaign of taunts or victory claims.
The interroom deal does not establish coalition membership caused by common-threat defense or verify that joint defense occurred.
Megathread coordination is visible, but the concepts do not establish that a flood of recruitment calls caused its creation.
Neither conditional self-appointment nor timing disagreement establishes a proposal-stage authority disclaimer or a post-agreement refusal within the revised arrow's bound.
